turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so we have until then. Owen found out about his zero on his phone in the middle of a class and nobody called me, so start with who decided that, and on what basis.
I spoke with the vice principal before you came in.
You spoke with the vice principal before I came in today, or before you entered the zero on November 3? Because your own procedure says you call me before any mark goes in, and nobody did.
She's backing me completely. Policy is policy, and it isn't up to you.

"Policy is policy." Good, I printed it: 4.2 says you contact me before any mark consequence is entered, and 4.3 says the software alone doesn't establish anything. If the vice principal is backing a zero that skipped both, then I'll have that in writing, with her name on it.
So frankly, this meeting is a courtesy.

"A courtesy." Your own procedure says this meeting was required before the zero went in, and it came a week late. Withdraw the zero, or tell me now that you won't, and I'm walking down to the principal's office when we're done here.
